declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement was reached through arm’s-length negotiations between class counsel and Brightline’s counsel. The negotiations addressed the class fund, attorneys’ fees and expenses, and distribution terms. The parties agreed to a $30 million class fund, automatic payments to identified class members, and a separate $4 million fee-and-expense amount subject to court approval. Brightline did not agree to clear sailing, and any fee amount the Court does not award will revert to the class rather than to Brightline. Because the negotiations were confidential mediation communications, this statement does not disclose their substance or the parties’ negotiating positions.
